we have developed a thermal diode consisting Ag2(S,Te) with a TRR = 2
a composite solid-state thermal diodes with a TRR = 2 was constructed by employing silver chalcogenides with a phase transition.
we have developed a high-performance thermal diode consisting Ag2(S, Se, Te), which is the first solid-state thermal diodes to exhibit thermal rectification ratios higher than 2.5.

the development of a thermal diode consisting only of Ag2(S1−xTex)Se1−x, which exhibits a high TRR of 2.7 +
the fabrication and characterization of a solid-state thermal rectifier, consisting of two silver chalcogenide compounds, Ag2S0,6Se0,4 and Ag2Te, which possess a high thermal rectification ratio.
a thermal diode that consists of two silver chalcogenides, Ag2(S, Se, Te) and Ag2(S, Te), and exhibits high rectification ratio of 2.7 at 300 K.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a thermal diode has been successfully developed, and it is expected to find applications in the field of thermal management.
Ag2(S,Te) is a promising material for the development of high-performance solid-state thermal diodes.
the thermal rectification ratio is the highest ever achieved for a solid-state device, and that the device is the first to exhibit such high rectification in the solid-state regime.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the TRR of a thermal diode is determined by the difference in the thermal conductivities of the two materials constituting it, and that the TRR can be increased by increasing the difference in their thermal conductivities.
the thermal diode performance can be improved by using materials possessing large thermal conductivity changes at phase transitions.
Ag2(S, Se, Te) is a promising candidate for constructing thermal diodes, and a composite thermal diode consisting Ag2(S, Te) and Ag2(S,Te) with a TRR = 2 can be easily fabricated.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the thermal conductivity of silver chalcogenides can be tuned to a large extent by controlling the phase transition temperature and the electron concentration.
the thermal diode performance can be enhanced by selecting appropriate materials with a large jump in thermal conductivity at a certain temperature.

the thermal rectification of Ag2(Sx,Se1-x) can be enhanced by selecting a suitable combination of the two materials, which is expected to lead to the development of high-performance solid-state thermal diodes.
